title: Onboard Kairos-13B v1.0: metadata, perf profiles, and changelog automation
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Motivation: Add Kairos-13B v1.0 to the model registry with complete metadata, curated performance profiles for common deployment shapes, and hooks to auto-generate changelog/release-note entries for registry releases. This unblocks Dedicated onboarding for teams validating throughput/latency on 2xA100 and 4xA10 pools and ensures releases are discoverable in the Console.

What this PR does:
- Adds model metadata (model card, sources, tokenizer, recommended quantization/compile settings).
- Adds performance profiles for 64/128/2048 context lengths and for batched/unbatched shapes. Profiles include throughput/tokens-per-second and KEYS for kernel/runtime tags.
- Adds unit tests and CI validations that assert perf profiles meet expected latency/throughput baselines on our perf-canary CI.
- Extends scripts/changelog-gen.py to pick up new registry entries and emit structured release notes (changelog YAML) used by the Console release feed.
- Adds docs: model card page and quickstart snippet for the API.

Checklist:
- [x] Metadata schema populated and validated
- [x] Perf profiles generated and checked in
- [x] Changelog automation wired to registry CI
- [x] Docs page added
- [x] Unit/integration tests added and passing

Notes on automation: changelog-gen.py now scans models/*/metadata.yaml and will append a release entry when a new model version is merged to main. The workflow is gated behind a small whitelist (registry-maintainers) to avoid accidental releases. Perf profile validation is implemented as a lightweight CI step that compares committed profiles against fixtures; heavy perf regressions still require manual triage.

Backwards compatibility: All changes are additive to the registry. No changes to the public API surface or runtime behavior.

Follow-ups: Add telemetry mapping from perf profile tags to Console dashboards (ENG-2253).

release_notes:
- Add Kairos-13B v1.0 to model registry with metadata and model card.
- Include curated performance profiles for common context lengths and GPU shapes.
- CI automation: perf profile validation and changelog generation for registry releases.
Impact: Teams can start validating Kairos on Dedicated pools; Console will surface release notes automatically.
notes: This PR was intentionally scoped to registry artifacts and CI automation only; runtime changes (compilation kernels) are tracked separately under ENG-2201.
